# netcup Provider

Manage netcup DNS and domains via the CCP (DomainWebservice) API, and reverse DNS / servers via the SCP REST API. The two APIs use independent credentials; configure whichever you need.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    netcup = {
      source = "hornc-greedy/netcup"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials may also be supplied via the environment variables
# NETCUP_CUSTOMER_NUMBER, NETCUP_API_KEY and NETCUP_API_PASSWORD.
provider "netcup" {
  customer_number = var.netcup_customer_number
  api_key         = var.netcup_api_key
  api_password    = var.netcup_api_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String) netcup CCP API key. May also be set via `NETCUP_API_KEY`.
- `api_password` (String, Sensitive) netcup CCP API password. May also be set via `NETCUP_API_PASSWORD`.
- `customer_number` (String) netcup customer number (CCP API). May also be set via `NETCUP_CUSTOMER_NUMBER`.
- `scp_refresh_token` (String, Sensitive) SCP REST API offline refresh token (obtained once via the OIDC device flow). Required only for SCP resources/data sources (reverse DNS, servers). May also be set via `NETCUP_SCP_REFRESH_TOKEN`.
